author: Vior_
body:
7 months ago... I was immature. I had no idea what combat logging was (until I got banned several times for it). I was posted a lifetime ban on this server and it broke my heart. I have not forgot about this server until I saw a YouTube vid by Porkyyy and it made me want to come back to the wonderful avicus community. Playing other servers for a while has taught me proper behavior and I would like another chance from this wonderful staff to become a part of the community again! So I would ask for a reply for a staff member so I can see if I can end my long ban. I have really changed since and I really miss this server. Please give me a chance!

Sport dude.

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing your infractions, I've decided to deny your appeal. You have too my infractions, after gaining this amount, you still continued to break rules which proved to us, that you didn't learn from your mistakes. Plus, you've already been punished for excessive infractions once, you got permanently banned because you didn't learn from all these infractions. I'm sorry, but your infraction will remain.

Best Regards,

Zeusy,

Avicus Senior Moderator
